policy: A CVE may be listed here only if it cannot be reached given FFMPEG_INPUT_GUARD (local files; mov/mp4/matroska/webm; h264/hevc/vp8/vp9/av1/mpeg4) and JPEG-only output, or if its worst case is a crash/hang that FFMPEG_TIMEOUT_MS kills. Anything else blocks ffmpeg until it is upgraded.

cves.reason: Memory leak in libavutil/mem.c; each ffmpeg run is a short-lived process.
Memory leak in libavutil/iamf.c; each ffmpeg run is a short-lived process.
sftp protocol handler; protocol_whitelist allows only local files.
Leaks bytes into remuxed/transcoded HDR10+ metadata; we only write JPEG frames, which carry no such metadata.
DASH demuxer infinite loop; format_whitelist excludes DASH.
Crafted MP4 pssh boxes crash the process or burn CPU; denial of service only, bounded by FFMPEG_TIMEOUT_MS.
RTSP redirect loop; protocol_whitelist allows only local files.
